scripts.build: pnpm run me && rm -rf public && hexo generate
scripts.deploy: pnpm run me && hexo clean && hexo deploy
scripts.lnconfig: rm -rf themes/concise/_config.yml && ln -f themes/replacement/_config.yml themes/concise/_config.yml && cat themes/replacement/footer.ejs > themes/concise/layout/_partial/footer.ejs && cat themes/replacement/include.js > themes/concise/scripts/include.js
scripts.me: pnpm run lnconfig && cp themes/images/* themes/concise/source/images/
